name: English
economy:
Virtual coins only. No money, gambling or cash-out.
/daily: 100 coins per 24 hours
/earn: 10 coins per minute
/pay: reviewed transfer 1-10000 coins
fallback: This language currently uses English fallback.
error_timeout: The service took too long. Try again later.
error_network: The network is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
error_storage: Storage is unavailable. No reset was attempted. Contact an administrator.
error_download: The download failed. Check the link and try again.
error_service: The service is unavailable or busy. Try again later.
error_input: Check the input or cooldown. Use /help for the correct format.
error_internal: This command could not finish. Contact an administrator with this reference.
help_intro:
Commands start with {prefix}.
{prefix}menu lists commands.
{prefix}help command shows usage.
Downloads have size and time limits.
desc_addsudo: Grant a mentioned user sudo command access
desc_antidelete: Recover deleted messages and statuses (sent to your own chat)
desc_compress: Make an image smaller in file size
desc_convert: Convert an image to png, jpg or webp
desc_deleted: Show recently deleted items I caught
desc_errors: Private error IDs and recurrence counts; no message contents
desc_filetype: Identify a safe file by content
desc_getpp: Get the profile picture of a user
desc_goodbye: Turn Goodbye message on or off (admins)
desc_help: Explain how to use the bot or one command
desc_html: Extract text from a public HTML page
desc_languages: Search all registered language codes; show translation coverage
desc_password: Create a private password without storing it
desc_pay: Review and confirm a virtual-coin transfer
desc_ping: Check that the bot is alive and how fast it replies
desc_pinterest: Find a Pinterest pin by name, or download one from a link
desc_quiz: Trivia with private sessions and scores
desc_resetlanguage: Reset your or group language to English
desc_resize: Resize an image to a width in pixels
desc_setlanguage: Set the group interface language (group admins)
desc_setprefix: Change the command prefix (any symbol, number, letter or emoji)
desc_status: Show bot status: uptime, memory, usage and more
desc_statusdl: List and download saved WhatsApp statuses
desc_sticker: Make a sticker from an image or short video
desc_toimg: Turn a sticker into an image
desc_tts: Turn text into a voice message
desc_update: Review and confirm a GitHub update
desc_vv: Recover a view-once photo or video
desc_welcome: Turn Welcome message on or off (admins)
desc_play: Download the audio of a YouTube video (M4A)
rules_summary: Reward rules: daily {daily}; earn {earn}; earn cooldown {seconds} seconds; maximum balance {maxBalance}.
welcome_default: Welcome {user} to {group}! Use /rules to see the group rules.
coverage: {registered} registered languages; {files} locale files; {complete} complete interface schemas. Missing keys use English.
locale_partial: Partial locale; missing keys use English.
locale_complete: Complete interface schema; legacy plugin text may still use English.
economy_notice: Virtual coins only. No money, gambling or cash-out. Use daily, earn or reviewed pay commands.
